about: The secreta of the formulary “3rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Look favorably, O Lord, upon the offerings of Your prayerful Church and grant that those who believe may, in continual holiness, partake of them for their salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
